up: z in this file (Blender); the GLBs are Y-up glTF
how: Each piece is its own GLB (close = *_lod0.glb, medium = *.glb) with its origin at its anchor: on the water line for pieces that stand in the sea (pillars, root base, entry, dock), at the piece's base for the rest (domes sit on a deck, the deck on its supports). Stone pieces carry a "foundation" mesh: straight columns from just above the water down to found_z, so they reach the sea floor anywhere; the terrain hides the rest. An assembly lists pieces with a position (at), a turn about up (yaw_deg) and a scale. placement_in_source = where the piece sat in its Meshy building.
sockets_help: footprint / top_outline: convex outlines (x, y) in the piece's own frame; z_min / z_max likewise.

horaro_dock.note: Modelled, not from Meshy. Posts run down to found_z so the dock reaches the sea floor.
